# S04J synthetic provider scenarios

Generated by `tools/s04j_make_fixtures.py` (deterministic). ALL DATA IS SYNTHETIC: DOIs use the Crossref test prefix 10.5555;
titles, authors, URLs (`*.example`) and counts are invented. Nothing here is real journal or publisher metadata.

- `jisa_shaped/`: only the ISSNs (2214-2126 print, 2214-2134 electronic) follow the JISA pilot. 2,226 Crossref records,
  an independent OpenAlex inventory with deliberate gaps, overlaps, conflicts and edge cases. The owner's historical
  Crossref count (2151, 2026-11-01) is NOT the fixture size and is never an expected value.
- `three_publishers/`: three mock journals styled after three publishers, plus `batch.json` (one invalid ISSN).

The simulated OpenAlex accepts one synthetic test key for deep paging; only its SHA-256 is stored in the scenario.
The key string itself lives in the test code and is not a credential for any real service.
